note: Proposed by handoff 027. Merge into docs/design/design-system/tokens.json (bump version to 4), then npm run tokens. glow-you joins the existing shadow group; motion-grow, blur-swap and peek start a new motion group. Values tuned against the Anchor recordings (027 SPEC §6) and checked for contrast (SPEC §4).

add.name: glow-you
add.usage: The one live thing on a screen (your live hole tile, your tee time in the lobby, your live rotation). Dark mode only; light mode uses the cart-you outline alone. Never on more than one element per screen, never on anything that isn't yours.

motion.note: Motion is short and functional. Grow / fold, sheets, score bumps and the reward motion (022) only. Every animation respects reduced motion.

tokens.name: motion-grow
tokens.usage: A quiet row growing into its card where you tapped, and the card folding back to a row. One tap = one motion-grow, even when one thing folds while another grows. A fold on its own (nothing opening) runs at 0.75 × (225ms).

tokens.name: blur-swap
tokens.usage: Peak blur when content changes inside a growing card: the old face blurs 0 → 8px and fades out over 0–40% of motion-grow (ease-in), the new face sharpens 8px → 0 and fades in over 20–100% (ease-out). Reduced motion: a 150ms cross-fade, no blur.

tokens.name: peek
tokens.usage: Opacity of the next thing waiting at the bottom edge (next rotation, other tee times). Text inside a peek is always `text`, never `text-muted`: at 0.6 it reads as muted and passes 4.5:1 for 12px labels in both themes (0.4 and 0.5 don't).
